title: Bark Fart Wind Mace
description: Makes mace combos really funny by changing the wind charge and mace sound effects.
body:
# Bark Fart Wind Mace
This pack is a very stupid one but it makes mace fights very funny to be in and watch.

Due to the way the **Wind Burst** was implemented, a mace hit with the wind burst enchantment will play both the bark and fart at the same time.
